verdict.rationale: Vanta documents parts of this story. Its API can 'offload employees in batches' (vanta-docs-23) and automate evidence collection for security awareness training (vanta-docs-32). Its audit API exposes in-scope personnel (vanta-docs-29), and it integrates with identity providers (vanta-docs-26). Missing for 10: HR-system sync, onboarding/offboarding checklists, proof that every leaver's access was revoked, per-hire training completion tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
